bulk.title: Export and import patient files
bulk.lead: One ZIP with a folder per patient: a PDF summary, every prescription, report, request, referral, certificate and invoice as PDF, the images and files as uploaded, and JSON data — with an Excel index of the patients and their folders.
bulk.how: The export is built in the background while you keep working; a large clinic can take a few minutes. The file stays 24 hours, then is removed.
bulk.confirm: Export every patient's file? The export is recorded in the clinic's log and every file's access log. Keep the file somewhere safe.
bulk.started: The export has started. Its progress shows here.
bulk.expires: Removed automatically 24 hours after it was made.
bulk.privacy: Each file holds only what you may see.
bulk.skipped_row: This file could not be included
bulk.readme:
Patient files — {n} patients — exported on {date}

index.xlsx / index.csv   every patient and their folder
patients/                one folder per patient with:
   00-summary.pdf        the file summary
   papers/               prescriptions, reports, requests, referrals, certificates, invoices (PDF)
   files/                images and files as uploaded
   data.json             the data in a portable form

import.title: Import patient files
import.lead: Upload a DocBook export (one patient's file or every patient's file) and everything goes back where it belongs: the patient, visits, diagnoses, prescriptions, requests, referrals, vital signs, images and files.
import.hint: A ZIP exported by DocBook, up to {mb} MB. Nothing is imported until you review it and confirm.
import.preview_lead: Review what the file holds before importing.
import.same: This file comes from this clinic: what still exists stays as it is, what was deleted comes back to its place.
import.other: This file comes from another clinic: everything is added as new records in this clinic.
import.rule_existing: A patient who already exists (same file, national ID, or name and phone) gets only what is missing.
import.rule_twice: Importing the same file again never doubles a visit or a file.
import.rule_money: Invoices and certificates are not re-created (their numbers and verification codes); their PDFs are added to the patient's files.
import.rule_future: Upcoming bookings are not imported, so they cannot clash with the schedule; book them again.
import.rule_storage: Images and files count toward the clinic's storage; if it fills up the import stops and tells you.
import.doctors_sub: For each doctor in the file pick the matching doctor here; visits and prescriptions are attributed to them.
import.doctor_unmatched: No doctor with this name here — pick one or leave it without a doctor.
import.confirm: Import the files of {n} patients into this clinic?
